gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all workflow schemes to understand the current configurations in our Jira instance.
gold.ideal: The response should include a list of all workflow schemes with their IDs and names.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new workflow scheme to apply a specific workflow to a set of issue types.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the creation of the workflow scheme with its ID and details.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to read multiple workflow schemes to analyze their configurations for integration purposes.
gold.ideal: The response should return the details of the requested workflow schemes.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to update existing workflow schemes to improve our issue tracking process.
gold.ideal: The response should indicate success and provide updated details of the workflow schemes.

gold.user: As a business analyst, I want to fetch a specific workflow scheme to review its configuration for a project.
gold.ideal: The response should return the details of the specified workflow scheme.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I need to update a workflow scheme to reflect changes in our project management process.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the update and return the modified workflow scheme details.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to delete an obsolete workflow scheme that is no longer in use.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the deletion of the workflow scheme.

gold.user: As a project coordinator, I want to check the default workflow associated with a workflow scheme.
gold.ideal: The response should return the details of the default workflow for the specified scheme.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I need to update the default workflow for a workflow scheme to ensure it aligns with our current processes.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the update and provide the new default workflow details.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve the workflow scheme associated with a specific issue type to understand its workflow.
gold.ideal: The response should return the workflow scheme details for the specified issue type.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to associate a new issue type with a workflow scheme to enhance our issue tracking.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the association and return the updated workflow scheme details.

gold.user: As a business analyst, I need to retrieve the workflow mappings for a specific workflow scheme to analyze its structure.
gold.ideal: The response should return the workflow mappings associated with the specified workflow scheme.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to update the workflow mappings for a workflow scheme to reflect process changes.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the update and provide the new workflow mappings.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to remove the default workflow from a workflow scheme that is no longer applicable.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the deletion of the default workflow.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to see which projects are using a specific workflow scheme to assess its impact.
gold.ideal: The response should return a list of projects associated with the specified workflow scheme.
